title.zh: 将甲米地省卡维特市镇普托尔村普托尔小学的名称变更为普托尔-圣伊莎贝尔小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Putol Elementary School in the Barrio of Putol, Municipality of Kawit, Province of Cavite, to Putol-Sta. Isabel Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Putol Elementary School in the Barrio of Putol, Municipality of Kawit, Province of Cavite, to Putol-Sta. Isabel Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1647_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Putol Elementary School located at the boundary of the barrios of Putol and Sta. Isabel, Municipality of Kawit, Province of Cavite, is changed to Putol-Sta. Isabel Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
